# Credential registry and effective-source monitoring

Source: docs/credentials-and-logins/index.html (AGT-2968), decisions D1, D5. Read workbench.json, registry.schema.json, inventory-design.json and runbooks.json in that directory. Use the recorded sight-review choices when promoted; the recommendations are not approval receipts.

Entry points: runner/ProviderCredentialMonitor.cs, runner/RunnerCapabilityProbe.cs, contracts/TaskServer.Contracts/CapabilityContracts.cs and the authoritative Task Server metadata store.

Deliver
Implement the metadata-only registry described in #inventory and registry.schema.json. Inventory kinds from inventory-design.json and service bindings without reading values into server storage. Discover effective auth mode from the daemon context and report shadowed files. Preserve unknown creation/expiry and distinguish access-token expiry from refreshable-session renewal. Extend capability summaries with credential generation, observed time, last success, expiry provenance and safe evidence references. Handle legacy readers with explicit protocol negotiation. Keep CLI-native refresh ownership and protect against stale-instance/generation writes. Do not implement a vault or automatic rotation in this slice.

Acceptance
- All ten catalogued credential kinds can be represented with owner, custody, scopes, renewal method and unknown dates.
- An active Claude environment token never inherits expiry from the stale native file; Codex access expiry does not become login expiry.
- Out-of-order observations cannot overwrite a newer generation; advertisements, logs and registry payloads contain no secret values.

Update affected public operations/contracts documentation and this Dossier's implementation log, and report exact verification. Preserve application-owned Git and workspace API boundaries. implementationTasks.title: I3 · Fleet admission and recovery for credential health
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Fleet admission and recovery for credential health

Source: docs/credentials-and-logins/index.html (AGT-2968), decisions D2, D4. Read workbench.json, registry.schema.json, inventory-design.json and runbooks.json in that directory. Use the recorded sight-review choices when promoted; the recommendations are not approval receipts.

Entry points: task-server/TaskServerCapabilityStore.cs, backend/Features/Tasks/LeaseEndpoints.cs, capability failure/recovery reporting and both runner daemons.

Deliver
Implement the four scoped fleet reactions in #probes in every supported claim path. Separate login validity from service availability, preserve provider-auth keys, and negotiate richer reason codes before enabling old UI consumers. Credential failures park only matching provider/account bindings and create one renewal item. Confirmed incidents pause the affected cohort with 60/120/300-second jittered retries and passive history only. Quota and network retain their existing policy owners. Persist circuit evidence, next retry and canary ownership so server restart or concurrent hosts cannot cause probe storms. Indeterminate failures get a diagnosis item only after the proposed 15-minute window. Recovery requires a real canary and fresh generation-matched advertisement. Do not kill active work, rewrite terminal cards or alter model selection.

Acceptance
- Coding and Review stop affected claims while other providers remain eligible; existing fences and active-attempt settlement remain valid.
- Confirmed incident produces zero renewal/action items; credential failure produces one deduplicated runbook-linked item.
- Concurrent retries and restart yield one canary per cohort; stale healthy evidence cannot clear a newer hold.
